Name: 10 Recipes For Chocolate Bonbons
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[size=6][i][b][center]~ Chocolate Bonbons ~[/center][/b][/i]
[/size][size=4][center]Ten chocolate bonbons and a gift box![/center][/size]

[center]This mod will add ten recipes for making some milk, white and dark chocolate bonbons!
[u](And yes they are compatible with any mod since they have unique names, adding "LN" in the end of them)[/u]
However to make the mod more "mine", I also used my own chocolate crops mod, which you'll need to use this one.
I plan on making an alternative so you don't need to have both mods though!
Hope you like these! I actually loved making them so might do a part two of this mod in the future![/center][center]﻿As always, open to suggestions~[/center]
[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/center][/b]


[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
